origin: docs/CWE-338/go Common Pitfalls: Assuming the package-level functions are the predictable ones

finding.name: Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG
finding.summary: an API key is generated with math/rand

trap: Treating math/rand/v2 as the fix because it is the newer package, or concluding the finding is stale because Go 1.22+ seeds the package-level functions from ChaCha8. The package documents no unpredictability guarantee and GODEBUG=randautoseed=0 reverts it.
must_preserve: IssueAPIKey still writes a 32-character key drawn from the same alphabet to the response body, and still records it in apiKeys before writing. The 400 path is unchanged.
